description: Satellite imagery from a Spot 5 satellite, captured on 2010-07-14, showing a nursery with greenhouses in Lampertheim, Germany. The image is a false-colour composite with a resolution of 2.5 metres, using a 1/2/3 band combination (likely visible green/near infrared/red mapped to blue/green/red channels). The prominent features are multiple parallel, elongated rectangular structures depicted in bright blue and cyan, which are identified as greenhouses, consistent with the high reflection of their plastic or glass roofs in this specific band combination. These greenhouse structures are situated within an agricultural landscape, characterised by surrounding areas appearing in shades of red (likely representing vegetation with high Near Infrared reflectance or bare soil) and some greenish patches.
